description: Recorded hourly history of one derived signal over the last 7 days ($0.005 USDC), e.g. sentiment or funding-predictions. Use to see how a signal moved, which public sources cannot give you after the fact. Needs signal=. Only signals with a gap-free record are offered.

payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 payment payload you signed yourself (ERC-3009 TransferWithAuthorization, USDC on Base). Call without it once to receive the payment requirements, sign those, then call again with this argument. This server forwards the payload and never holds a key.

signal.description: Which recorded signal, e.g. sentiment, volatility, funding-rates

name: get_signal_history_7d
